pr2309.body:
## LSC-2OP: operator local-seat controls

Adds Manage local seats to co-op entry. The operator can list, provision, re-provision and revoke either seat using the primary vault password. Each submit creates a new operation id. Password inputs clear immediately; credentials stay request-local and never enter browser storage.

- The next expected generation comes from the operation outcome, including a replay whose current seat snapshot has advanced. GENERATION_CONFLICT and OPERATION_MISMATCH both refresh the form without automatically retrying the write; mismatch has no invented generation. Failed refresh disables writes until explicit recovery.
- Public seat state includes status, label, playerId, generation and lock deadline. Errors distinguish denied credentials from throttling and display Retry-After.
- Discloses operator impersonation/shared-OS limits, new identity and GM readmission after re-provision, existing bearer validity until expiry, and old membership until explicit removal.

### Scope and carry-forwards

Starts at independently fetched LSC-1 closure #2308, merge 545073d83c9d23781a75a93565dbdcf87cac5786. Fresh recursive ownership census covers every literal, ancestor alias, planned/blocked reservation and open PR. Only LSC-2OP lifecycle fields change; LSC-2 stays blocked.

Carries CF-LSC1S-4, CF-LSC1-3/7 and CF-LSC0-3/7/10/12. The ordinary chooser, join, primary/guest renewal, expiry recovery and forget/reclaim remain LSC-2; packaged/browser acceptance remains LSC-2P. Primary mint, identity, bearer storage and server policy are unchanged.

### Known-red salvage: separate amendment required

The registered LSC-2OP leaves exclude every leaf in baseline-f-salvage.patch (sha256 18bed5da2931d284b8d942eac3c85c72012cd1936f402d8c9986842a250562a0). Per Root's direction, it is not applied. Campaign-economy remains KNOWN-RED under LSC-2OP ownership; release still requires 12/12 on npm run verify:qc:campaign-economy:browser after a registered repair. No browser PASS is claimed here.

Required salvage leaves for Root's amendment:

- e2e/campaign-economy-browser.spec.ts
- src/pages/gameplay/campaigns/[id]/salvage.tsx
- src/stores/campaign/__tests__/campaignBayActions.test.ts
- src/stores/campaign/__tests__/salvageUnitEnrollment.test.ts
- src/stores/campaign/campaignBayActions.ts
- src/stores/campaign/salvageUnitEnrollment.ts
- src/types/campaign/Salvage.ts

### Validation

- Fresh npm ci on Node 22.22.0. Every Jest/typecheck run uses heavy-run.mjs --lane lsc --class jest.
- Runtime RED: 28 new assertion failures, 23 existing entry tests pass. The initial virtual-mock alias configuration error was fixed before the recorded RED.
- GREEN: Test Suites: 3 passed, 3 total; Tests:       51 passed, 51 total.
- Regression: Test Suites: 67 passed, 67 total; Tests:       1119 passed, 1119 total; typecheck PASS.

- Full lint/format, strict OpenSpec, OpenSpec QC, roadmap plain/--git/--next, 86 validator tests and lint:units PASS.
